seo_title: Discover the Passion and Talent of DJ Michael C - JAMMIN' DJs Georgia & Tennessee
seo_description: Discover DJ Michael C's passion for music and creating unforgettable experiences at events. From parties to festivals, he ensures every moment is memorable.
body_html:
Since 2016, Michael C has been turning events into unforgettable experiences. As a DJ, his favorite part is curating genuine human interactions and reactions in festive settings. Michael brings his vibrant energy to a variety of events, including sporting events, award ceremonies, parties, and festivals, ensuring that every moment is memorable.

Beyond the turntables, Michael is a talented guitarist, performing in both professional and church settings. With over 15 years of experience in writing and recording music for his peers, his passion for music is evident in every beat he plays.

In his spare time, Michael enjoys organizing local sporting events centered around basketball, skateboarding, and disc golf. Additionally, he has a keen interest in repairing vintage audio gear, showcasing his love for all things music and sound.

Join Michael C at your next event for an experience filled with great music, lively interactions, and lasting memories.
